ety.text: Arabic سُوَيْدَاء (suwaydāʔ)bor. Italian sodabor. English soda Proto-Indo-European *-om Proto-Italic *-om Latin -umder. English -ium English sodium Coined by British chemist Humphry Davy in 1808, from soda + -ium.

senses.d: The chemical element (symbol Na) with an atomic number of 11 and atomic weight of 22.990. It is a soft, waxy, silvery, reactive alkali metal that is never found unbound in nature.

ety.text: From New Latin sodium, probably from Arabic صُدَاع (ṣudāʕ, “headache”), due to the headache-alleviating properties.
